references.text: Here the sons of Naphtali are mentioned: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem, who are the ancestors of the clans listed in Numbers 26:48.
Naphtali was born to Bilha, Rachel's maidservant, as Jacob's sixth son.
The first census of the tribe of Naphtali in the wilderness, which provides the background for the clans counted in chapter 26.
The sons of Naphtali are mentioned here: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem, corresponding to the clans in Numbers 26:48.
